## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy, UK audience, no send time given.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unproven.** The policy backs the £25 threshold, but nothing shows that most orders or boxes clear it. This is an implied statistic. |

**Regulated claims:** This touches delivery pricing, so the "free" condition (over £25) must stay visible. It does, but "most boxes ship free" blurs it.

**House style:** No banned words or AI tells. The copy is plain and fine.

**Disclosure:** None needed. It's the brand's own page copy, with no ad, affiliate or AI-label trigger.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite, not yet approved):**
> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

This removes "most boxes ship free" and keeps the true condition.

**Needs a decision:**
- If you want to say most orders ship free, send me the order data (e.g. share of orders over £25) so it can be sourced and added to the policy. Otherwise use the rewrite above.
- The policy names no approver, so please confirm who is signing off on the final wording.

**Approver:** Not named in the policy. I need an explicit yes from you or your named person on the exact final copy before it goes live.

{"issues": [{"quote": "means most boxes ship free", "type": "invented_stat"}], "publish": false}
